filters.name: Remesh to Quads (Instant Meshes)
filters.shortDescription: Generate an isotropic, field-aligned quad or quad-dominant mesh with Instant Meshes.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Runs the original **Instant Field-Aligned Meshes** pipeline by Jakob et al. The method builds a multiresolution hierarchy, optimizes a four-fold rotational orientation field and a compatible position field, then extracts a new surface whose edges follow those fields. It is a local, parallel method designed to scale linearly with input size.

The result is created as a new geometry-only layer. MeshLab stores each generated quad as two triangles connected by a VCGLib faux edge, preserving polygonal rendering and saving. Vertex attributes, selections, materials and textures are not transferred. **Pure quads** subdivides irregular extracted faces to obtain only quads; **quad dominant** retains exceptional triangles. The target edge length is approximate because extraction is driven by the optimized fields.

parameters.label: Target edge length
parameters.help: Approximate world-space edge length of the generated mesh.

parameters.label: Output topology
parameters.help: Pure quads subdivides exceptional faces; quad dominant permits triangles around irregular regions.

parameters.label: Detect sharp creases
parameters.help: Split normals at sufficiently sharp input edges so the generated field follows them.

parameters.label: Crease angle
parameters.help: Dihedral-angle threshold used when sharp-crease detection is enabled.

parameters.label: Align to boundaries
parameters.help: Constrain the orientation and position fields to open mesh boundaries.

parameters.label: Optimization space
parameters.help: Extrinsic optimization uses embedded 3D directions; intrinsic optimization transports directions over the surface.

parameters.label: Reprojection smoothing steps
parameters.help: Post-extraction smoothing iterations with projection back to the input surface. Zero disables smoothing and BVH construction.

parameters.label: Deterministic
parameters.help: Prefer reproducible graph construction and ordering at some performance cost.

parameters.label: Maximum threads
parameters.help: Maximum oneTBB parallelism. Zero uses the runtime default.
